sources.title: README.md
sources.locator: Install; Quick Start; What it does; Git Branch Controls; Requirements
sources.finding: Product CLI creates tmux agent panes, Git worktrees/branches, merge and GitHub PR workflows. Named agents include Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, Pi, Cursor and others. Durable terminal/harness recovery, file browser/diff previews, notifications and lifecycle hooks are described. Optional inference can reuse Codex ChatGPT or Grok Build subscription login.

sources.title: dmux: src/index.ts
sources.locator: CLI entry; src/types.ts; src/utils/agentLaunch.ts; src/services/TmuxService.ts; settingsManager.ts; actions; hook dispatch
sources.finding: The shipped entry point is a local Node/tmux TUI; no desktop, native-phone or active HTTP ADE client is wired to it (src/server/embedded-assets.ts is not referenced by the runtime). AgentLaunch has a closed AGENT_IDS/registry without Aider or Antigravity. Tmux processes and Git worktrees run on the host where dmux is invoked; no vendor cloud, container/VM provisioner, coordinator-agent role, native issue model, team roles/SSO, shared-user prompting service or task scheduler is implemented. Lifecycle hook scripts are separate. No telemetry SDK/toggle is implemented.
